title: ClaimMinted event emits nominal `price` rather than `actualReceived`
description: Off-chain indexers see `pricePaid = price`, but the protocol actually received `actualReceived` (relevant for FOT tokens or H-01's fake-token scenario). Price-growth ratchet also uses nominal `price` at line 185, so FOT tokens desynchronize on-chain price curve from real revenue.
impact: Off-chain analytics misrepresent protocol revenue; price-growth curve diverges from actual received value when FOT tokens are used.
attack_path: User mints using FOT token (or via H-01 fake token).
Event emits nominal price, not actualReceived.
Indexers and on-chain price ratchet desynchronize from real receipts.
recommendation: Emit `actualReceived` in the event and use `actualReceived` in the growth ratchet formula.
